CustomField.description: Resolved when closed; else Breached past due; else Due Soon in the final 30% of the SLA window; else On Track. The 30% due-soon window is the one working assumption — change it here only.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(Is_Open__c), "🟢 Resolved", IF(NOW() > SLA_Due_DateTime__c, "🔴 Breached", IF((SLA_Due_DateTime__c - NOW()) * 24 <= 0.30 * SLA_Target_Hours__c, "🟡 Due Soon", "🟢 On Track")))
CustomField.label: SLA Health
